CHEMISTRY — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.

   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
